title: Gary Nolan's CIA file on UFO experiencers and Havana syndrome

tellings.quote: And I remember talking to Gary Nolan and he mentioned that he was kind of given a file by the CIA and he was tasked with looking into this.

plain: A scientist named Garry Nolan is said to have been handed a file by the CIA, the US spy agency, and asked to study it, a file about people who say they had UFO encounters and about Havana syndrome, the strange injuries reported by US officials. Michels says Nolan told him this himself, mentioning he was "kind of given a file by the CIA and he was tasked with looking into this." It would mean the agency was quietly studying these cases.
